name: Operational issue and attachment-correction email chain

patterns_used: Use a controlled two-page form with explicit lifecycle, approvals, implementation, distribution, optional attachments, and retention metadata.
foundation_lineage.transformation_boundary: Reuse only the lifecycle, distribution, attachment, and retention control concepts; do not reproduce the reviewed form, its layout, content, identities, or approval evidence.

producer: Operations manager, analyst, and external counterparty
purpose: Coordinate an operational exception, circulate support, correct one attachment, and leave a bounded open item.
medium: Native MIME email thread with ordinary attachments
lifecycle: Sent and received thread retained in the project file

authority.governing_scope: Records who communicated an exception, correction, attachment, and open action.
authority.non_governing_scope: Does not turn correspondence into approval or replace the attached governing record.

authorized_inputs: Approved fictional-world participants, events, and attachments
Role-specific knowledge available at each message time
excluded_inputs: Facts unknown to the sender at message time
Private task answers and generator notes
source_boundary.conflict_resolution: Attachments govern their own contents; later corrections supersede earlier attachments only when the thread states that boundary.

natural_depth: Initial request and incomplete first response
Internal shorthand and external formal reply
One unresolved owner and due date
footprint.source_owned_rationale: Message and attachment counts arise from request, incomplete response, correction, coordination, and retention events in the operational lifecycle.

sequence: Open item assigned and thread retained

features: One printed retained copy only if separately manifested

prohibited: Perfectly complete reply from every participant
Attachment facts absent from the attachments
Thread that directly states the task answer

proof_gates.procedure: Parse MIME structure and verify thread order, headers, attachments, and correction state.
Render every message body and open and inspect every attachment.
Inspect MIME headers, message identifiers, timestamps, encodings, and attachment names.
Confirm the email body contains no material calculation contract.
proof_gates.not_applicable_rationale: Any calculations are owned and validated by separately manifested attachments.

proof_gates.procedure: Trace participants, attachment versions, and known facts to the approved world manifest.
Scan bodies, quoted text, headers, and attachments for prohibited residue.
Distinguish contextual correspondence, corrected support, and any governing attachment.
Map each message and attachment to a credible operational communication event.
